field_changes.old: Handful of bug fixes and reliability improvements.
field_changes.new: Your custom training plans just got smarter — DIY plans now support full mesocycle periodization, with JEFIT guiding you through each training phase, progressively adjusting your weights and reps, and celebrating phase completions along the way. Pull-to-refresh on the Discover and Progress tabs is also noticeably snappier. Plus a handful of bug fixes and reliability improvements.
